en_title: Assassin's Creed Valhalla is Getting New Game+ Six Years After Release
cn_title: 《刺客信条：英灵殿》六年后追加二周目
subtitle: 姗姗来迟
opus_summary: 育碧宣布，《刺客信条：英灵殿》将在发售六年后，于11月5日加入新游戏＋模式，带来新符文、成就及储藏系统。官方还预告将公布本世代主机更新消息，具体内容尚不明确。

paragraphs.en: Assassin's Creed Valhalla launched all the way back in November 2020, but Ubisoft just announced that it's getting its own new game+ mode.
paragraphs.cn: 《刺客信条：英灵殿》早在2020年11月就已发售，但育碧直到现在才宣布，将为本作加入新游戏＋模式。

paragraphs.en: In a blog post, Ubisoft laid out some of its future plans for Assassin's Creed. One of them is a tiny, yet cryptic, update on Assassin's Creed: Codename Hexe . It also announced new game+ mode for Valhalla a mere six years after it first hit consoles.
paragraphs.cn: 育碧在一篇博客文章中介绍了《刺客信条》系列的部分未来计划，其中包括关于《Assassin's Creed: Codename Hexe》的一点新消息，只是内容颇为隐晦。此外，育碧还宣布将为《刺客信条：英灵殿》加入新游戏＋模式，距离本作首次登陆主机也「不过」才六年。

paragraphs.en: The new game mode will be coming on November 5, and will include a new, optional progression mode, along with new runes, achievements and a stash system. Ubisoft will also be adding a new crafting material, Mithril, which can be used to upgrade divine gear.
paragraphs.cn: 新游戏＋模式将于11月5日上线，包含一种全新的可选成长模式，以及新符文、成就和储藏系统。育碧还将加入新的制作材料秘银（Mithril），玩家可用它升级神级装备。

paragraphs.en: But on top of the NG+ mode, Ubisoft teased that Valhalla will be getting even more updates. In the post, Ubisoft says it will "share full details in the upcoming Patch Notes, along with news regarding current-generation console updates in the coming days." It's not clear what Ubisoft means by "current-generation console updates," but I'd bet on a nice little graphics boost.
paragraphs.cn: 除了新游戏＋模式，育碧还预告，《刺客信条：英灵殿》将迎来更多更新。育碧在文中表示，将「在即将发布的补丁说明中分享完整细节，并在未来几天公布本世代主机更新的相关消息」。目前尚不清楚育碧所说的「本世代主机更新」具体指什么，不过我猜，应该会有一些不错的画面提升。

paragraphs.en: While Valhalla does have a PS5 and Xbox Series version, the game hasn't received a PS5 Pro Enhanced glow-up, so I'd guess that's what Ubisoft meant by console updates. But even outside of the Pro, in the years since Valhalla came out, every console has been updated with better upscaling, whether that's QSSR on the base PS5 or FSR 4.1 on the Xbox Series consoles.
paragraphs.cn: 虽然《刺客信条：英灵殿》已有PS5和XBOX Series版本，但尚未获得PS5 Pro增强支持，因此我猜育碧所说的主机更新指的就是这个。不过，即便不算PS5 Pro，自本作发售以来，各款主机也都通过更新获得了更好的超分辨率技术，包括基础款PS5上的QSSR，以及XBOX Series主机上的FSR 4.1。

paragraphs.en: Assassin's Creed was well received at launch. When IGN reviewed it, we gave it an 8, with reviewer Brandin Tyrrel saying, "Assassin's Creed Valhalla is a massive, beautiful open-world fueled by brutal living and the dirty work of conquerors. It's a lot buggier than it should be but also impressive on multiple levels."
paragraphs.cn: 这部《刺客信条》作品在发售时收获了不错的评价。IGN为其打出8分，评测者Brandin Tyrrel表示：「《刺客信条：英灵殿》呈现了一个庞大而美丽的开放世界，残酷的生存与征服者的肮脏勾当推动着这个世界运转。游戏的Bug多得不应该，但它也在多个方面令人印象深刻。」

paragraphs.en: The new game+ mode isn't the first time Ubisoft has slow-walked updates for Assassin's Creed Valhalla. Players also had to wait nearly two years to get Steam achievements , and the company was still fixing bugs with the game as late as January 2025.
paragraphs.cn: 育碧拖到现在才推出新游戏＋模式，并不是《刺客信条：英灵殿》的更新第一次姗姗来迟。玩家此前也等了近两年才迎来Steam成就支持，而育碧直到2025年1月仍在修复本作的Bug。
